name: jcodebuddy-doc-tools
description: Documentation tooling for the jcodebuddy repository. The Java modules build with Maven (see merge-java/, hipster-entity/hipster-entity-example/); this manifest exists only so the repository can depend on the published @hrg/inject-examples CLI and drive it from the root npm scripts.
comment: `wyhash` is a LINK to the hash project's own checkout (github.com/hrgdavor/wyhash), not a copy: fs-meta's Bun port imports the hash from there (`import { wyhash64 } from 'wyhash/js/wyhash64.mjs'`), so the two ports of fs-meta hash with the same code, and an edit in that project is visible here immediately. One-time setup on a machine or a fresh clone: run `bun link` once inside the wyhash checkout (it registers the package), then `bun install` here. The Java half resolves the same project as the artifact `hr.hrg:wyhash` — installed from that checkout until 1.1.0 is published; see fs-meta/pom.xml. If the JavaScript port is ever published to npm, this specifier becomes a version range and the setup step disappears.
